sinopsis.es: Algo monstruoso acecha frente a la costa en esta miniserie llena de suspenso, ambientada en Terranova y protagonizada por Josh Hartnett (Trap) y Mackenzie Davis (Station Eleven).
sinopsis.en: Something monstrous lurks off the coast in this suspenseful, Newfoundland-set limited series, starring Josh Hartnett (Trap) and Mackenzie Davis (Station Eleven).
